title: Cotelligent Tax Saving Flexi Benefit Policy

sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The Tax Saving Flexi Benefit Policy defines the components of the Flexible Benefits Plan (FBP) that are exempt from income tax under the Income Tax Act, 1961. Associates can choose to structure their compensation by opting into these components to reduce their taxable income. This policy applies to all full-time permanent employees who receive an FBP as part of their CTC structure.

sections.title: Mobile / Phone Bill Reimbursement
paragraphs: Associates can claim reimbursement for mobile or telephone bills up to Rs. 3,000/- per month (Rs. 36,000/- per year). This amount is exempt from income tax when supported by original bills.

The phone connection must be in the associate's name. Both postpaid and prepaid bills are acceptable. The reimbursement covers the cost of the phone plan only; handset purchases are not covered under this component.
Claims must be submitted monthly in ZOHO with the original bill as supporting documentation.

sections.title: Driver Salary Reimbursement
paragraphs: Associates can claim reimbursement for driver salary up to Rs. 30,000/- per month (Rs. 3,60,000/- per year). This reimbursement is tax-exempt subject to submission of valid proof.

The driver must be employed personally by the associate. Required documentation: signed salary receipt from the driver, driver's address proof, and a declaration by the associate. The associate must own or lease a vehicle for which the driver is employed.
This component is applicable only when the associate has opted for it in their salary structure at the time of joining or during annual revision.

sections.title: Food Coupons / Meal Allowance
paragraphs: Associates can claim meal allowance up to Rs. 2,000/- per month (Rs. 24,000/- per year) which is exempt from income tax as per the provisions of the Income Tax Act.

Food coupons are provided in digital or physical form and can be used at authorized food outlets and restaurants. No bills are required for claiming this benefit — a monthly declaration is sufficient.
Associates who opt for this component will receive the food coupon credit by the 1st week of each month.

sections.title: National Pension Scheme (NPS)
paragraphs: Associates can contribute to the National Pension Scheme (NPS) through the employer as part of the Flexi Benefits Plan. The employer NPS contribution of up to 10% of basic salary is exempt from tax under Section 80CCD(2) of the Income Tax Act.

To avail NPS under FBP, associates must have an active NPS account (PRAN — Permanent Retirement Account Number). The contribution is made directly to the NPS account and cannot be withdrawn except under NPS withdrawal rules.
Associates opting for NPS must provide their PRAN number to the HR/payroll team. NPS contributions are made monthly by the employer to the employee's Tier-I NPS account.

sections.title: How to Opt In
paragraphs: Associates can opt into FBP components at the time of joining or during the annual FBP declaration period (typically April each year). Changes to FBP selections are generally not permitted mid-year except in specific life events (marriage, new child, etc.) approved by HR.

All FBP claims must be submitted through the ZOHO HR system by the 25th of each month. Annual FBP declarations must be submitted by the deadline communicated by the HR team to ensure correct tax computation.

sections.title: Important Tax Notes
paragraphs: FBP reimbursements are tax-exempt only up to the limits prescribed and when supported by valid documentation. Any amount claimed beyond the approved limit or without valid proof will be treated as taxable perquisite and TDS will be deducted accordingly.

Associates are personally responsible for ensuring the accuracy and authenticity of documents submitted for FBP claims. Submission of fraudulent documents constitutes misconduct and is subject to disciplinary action and recovery of the tax benefit availed.
